test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: Which river system enters Indian territory in Jammu and Kashmir by forming a picturesque gorge?
solution:
The correct answer is **'Indus River System'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indus River System is a Himalayan river system** and is one of the largest river basins in the world.
 
• The Indus Rivier is also **known as Sindhu**.
 
• Therefore, the Sindhu River System is a part of one of the most fertile regions of the Indian sub-continent and the world.
 
• Some of the Indian subcontinent's river systems existed long before civilizations existed.
 
• One such river system is the Indus River System. The main Tributaries of the Indus River form the **Indus River System, which includes Indus, Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, Beas, and Satluj.**
 
• As the** Indus River flows through both India and Pakistan,** the Indus water treaty was signed in 1960 for water sharing. Indus River System
 
• [IMAGE: https://lotusarise.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/Indus-River-System-UPSC.jpg] ​

 

 

 

 

 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Narmada River System:**

 
 
• **​**The Narmada, the largest west flowing river of the Peninsula, **rises near Amarkantak range of mountains** in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is the fifth largest river in the country and the largest one in Gujarat. It traverses Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra and Gujarat and meets the Gulf of Cambay.
 
 
 
• **Godavari River System: **
 
 
• **​**The Godavari is the largest Peninsular river system. It is also called the Dakshin Ganga.
 
• Godavari river** rises from Trimbakeshwar near Nasik** in Maharashtra and flows for a length of about 1450 km before falling into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• **Tributaries:** Pravara, Purna, Manjra, Penganga, Wardha, Wainganga, Pranhita, Indravati, Maner and the Sabri.
 
 
 
• **Brahmaputra River System:**
 
 
• The river **originates from the Kailash ranges of Himalayas** at an elevation of 5300 M.
 
• After flowing through Tibet it enters India through Arunachal Pradesh and flows through Assam and Bangladesh before it joins Bay of Bengal.
 
• **​**The Brahmaputra River System (3848 km) is one of the longest rivers of the world. It is known as the **Yarlung Tsangpo River in Tibet**, the **Brahmaputra, Lohit, Siang, and Dihang in India**, and the **Jamuna in Bangladesh**. 
 
• Tributaries: 
 
 
• Left bank tributaries are the Burhi Dihing, Dhansari (South) and Kalang.
 
• Right bank tributaries are the Subansiri, Kameng, Manas and Sankosh.
